BiblicalUsage: This word means to mark out a boundary, and it appears once, in the drawing of Israel's eastern border from Hazar-enan to Shepham. A line on the map, drawn by God's command.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God cares about boundaries — he gave his people a land with edges, and he gives my life edges too.
